classification_key.error_path: The mutation changes validation, refusal, recovery, or invalid-state handling; deferred triage should construct the legitimate state and the failing state separately.
classification_key.likely_equivalent: Source-level hypothesis only: the syntax mutation may preserve the externally observable contract. Confirm exact behavioral and byte-level expectations before dismissing it.
classification_key.test_gap: The mutation changes a normal behavior predicate or default; existing tests did not distinguish it. Deferred triage should identify the missing behavior case.
